description: Golden query set for prompt A/B regression (P2-8, IBM iterate-and-refine). Real recurring questions from production usage — lot counts, sales reports, forecast asks, follow-ups. The runner evaluates prompt variants against these and persists verdicts to prompt_ab_tests.
queries: How many inventory lots do we have?
Provide the total number of inventory lots
Give me a sales report for last month broken down by product
Top 10 materials by revenue this quarter
What is the contract execution rate by customer?
Show me inventory levels by warehouse
export last month's sales as a PPT
Is the price forecast for product X trending up or down?
How many lots were received in July 2026?
